note: 中文译文按课文语境自译，课本原文无中文对照，仅供跟读理解参考

items.en: Good morning, everyone!
items.zh: 大家早上好！

items.en: Who is on weather duty today?
items.zh: 今天谁值日报告天气？

items.en: It’s me!
items.zh: 是我！

items.en: Today is Monday, March 1.
items.zh: 今天是星期一，三月一号。

items.en: The temperature will reach 15°C by noon and drop to 2°C at night.
items.zh: 中午气温会升到15摄氏度，夜里降到2摄氏度。

items.en: Overall, it will be a warm, cloudy day.
items.zh: 总的来说，今天是温暖多云的一天。

items.en: Well done, Wang Mei.
items.zh: 说得真好，王梅。

items.en: The days are getting longer, and spring is coming.
items.zh: 白天越来越长，春天就要来了。

items.en: We have a school project on March 12.
items.zh: 三月十二日我们有一个学校活动。

items.en: Can you guess what it is?
items.zh: 你们能猜到是什么吗？

items.en: Is it tree planting?
items.zh: 是去植树吗？

items.en: Good guess.
items.zh: 猜得真准。

items.en: Do you know how to plant trees?
items.zh: 你们知道怎么种树吗？

items.en: Yes.
items.zh: 知道。

items.en: I learned to plant trees when I visited my uncle last spring.
items.zh: 去年春天我去舅舅家，学会了种树。

items.en: It was so much fun.
items.zh: 那可真好玩。

items.en: Could you tell us the steps for planting trees?
items.zh: 你能告诉我们植树的步骤吗？

items.en: Sure.
items.zh: 当然可以。

items.en: First, dig a large hole.
items.zh: 先挖一个大坑。

items.en: Then, place the seedling inside the hole, and cover its roots with soil.
items.zh: 然后把树苗放进坑里，用土盖住树根。

items.en: Finally, press down the soil.
items.zh: 最后把土压实。

items.en: Oh, don’t forget to water the tree.
items.zh: 哦，别忘了给树浇水。

items.en: Excellent, Li Ming.
items.zh: 讲得太好了，李明。

items.en: Why do people plant trees?
items.zh: 人们为什么要种树呢？

items.en: Do you have any ideas?
items.zh: 你们有什么想法吗？

items.en: Trees help protect the soil from rainfall.
items.zh: 树木能保护土壤不被雨水冲走。

items.en: Trees prevent dust from spreading.
items.zh: 树木能挡住灰尘，不让它到处飞扬。

items.en: Good points.
items.zh: 说得都有道理。

items.en: Planting trees is also a wonderful way to learn more about nature.
items.zh: 植树也是了解大自然的好办法。

items.en: I believe you will have a great time with this project.
items.zh: 我相信你们一定会在这个活动里玩得很开心。

items.en: Dear Jenny, Today is March 6.
items.zh: 亲爱的詹妮，今天是三月六日。

items.en: Jingzhe falls on this day this year.
items.zh: 今年惊蛰正好就在今天。

items.en: Do you know what Jingzhe is?
items.zh: 你知道惊蛰是什么吗？

items.en: It is one of China’s 24 solar terms, and it means “awakening of insects”.
items.zh: 它是中国二十四节气之一，意思是万物复苏、虫儿苏醒。

items.en: The spring thunder wakes insects up from their sleep.
items.zh: 春雷把昆虫从冬眠中唤醒。

items.en: Then nature begins to come back to life.
items.zh: 接着大自然就开始复苏了。

items.en: Spring is in the air.
items.zh: 春天已经到来。

items.en: This morning, the temperature was 10°C in my city.
items.zh: 今天早上，我市气温是10摄氏度。

items.en: It reached 15°C this afternoon.
items.zh: 下午升到了15摄氏度。

items.en: It was quite warm.
items.zh: 挺暖和的。

items.en: I don’t need my heavy winter coat or boots now!
items.zh: 我现在不用穿厚重的冬衣和靴子啦！

items.en: On my way to school, I saw some winter jasmine blossoming.
items.zh: 上学路上，我看见迎春花开了。

items.en: People believe the blossom of this flower always tells the coming of spring, so we call winter jasmine “the welcoming-spring flower”.
items.zh: 人们觉得这种花开就意味着春天来了，所以叫它迎春花。

items.en: I like spring.
items.zh: 我喜欢春天。

items.en: It is the best season for going out.
items.zh: 它是最适合出去玩的季节。

items.en: We are going to be more active, like insects!
items.zh: 我们也要像虫子一样活跃起来啦！

items.en: We will form a music band.
items.zh: 我们要组建一个乐队。

items.en: There is going to be a basketball game next week.
items.zh: 下周还有一场篮球赛。

items.en: My class is also planning a field trip.
items.zh: 我们班也在计划一次户外郊游。

items.en: We will plant trees.
items.zh: 我们要去种树。

items.en: I can’t wait!
items.zh: 我等不及啦！

items.en: What’s the weather like in Canada?
items.zh: 加拿大的天气怎么样？

items.en: What type of classic spring activities do you do?
items.zh: 你们春天会做哪些经典的活动？

items.en: Wang Mei
items.zh: 王梅

items.en: When we talk about spring, we think of a season of warm weather and fresh air.
items.zh: 说起春天，我们想到的是温暖的天气和清新的空气。

items.en: We also think of new life, green plants, and budding trees all around us.
items.zh: 还有新的生命、绿色的植物，以及周围发芽的树木。

items.en: Spring is short in many places around the world.
items.zh: 春天在世界许多地方都很短暂。

items.en: But in my hometown, it feels like spring nearly all year round.
items.zh: 但在我的家乡，几乎一年到头都像春天。

items.en: The weather here is neither too hot nor too cold.
items.zh: 这里的天气既不太热也不太冷。

items.en: The average temperature in winter is 15°C.
items.zh: 冬天平均气温是15摄氏度。

items.en: In summer, the average temperature is 24°C.
items.zh: 夏天平均气温是24摄氏度。

items.en: While the sun is shining, the temperature remains pleasant.
items.zh: 阳光照耀时，气温一直很宜人。

items.en: The city gets about 2,250 hours of sunshine and about 1,000 millimetres of rain every year.
items.zh: 这座城市每年约有2250小时日照，约1000毫米降水。

items.en: Because the weather is spring-like, you can find hundreds of beautiful flowers and trees all year round.
items.zh: 因为气候像春天，一年四季都能看到成百上千的美丽花草树木。

items.en: There are many famous scenic spots in my hometown.
items.zh: 我的家乡有许多著名的景点。

items.en: The Stone Forest is a must-see for tourists from home and abroad.
items.zh: 石林是国内外游客必看的地方。

items.en: There are many special rocks that look like tall stone trees.
items.zh: 那里有许多奇特的岩石，像高高的石树。

items.en: The Dianchi Lake is the biggest in Yunnan Province.
items.zh: 滇池是云南省最大的湖泊。

items.en: You can enjoy the beauty of the area and go boating or take a walk by the water.
items.zh: 你可以欣赏美景，也可以划船或在湖边散步。

items.en: Can you guess the name of my hometown?
items.zh: 你能猜出我家乡的名字吗？

items.en: Yes, it’s Kunming — the Spring City.
items.zh: 没错，就是昆明——春城。

items.en: Welcome to my hometown.
items.zh: 欢迎来到我的家乡。

items.en: When you visit, you will feel our warmth and friendliness, just like spring!
items.zh: 你来了一定会感受到我们像春天一样的热情和友好！

items.en: Groundhog Day is on February 2.
items.zh: 土拨鼠日在二月二日。

items.en: On that day, a small animal called groundhog comes out of its hole in the ground.
items.zh: 那一天，一种叫土拨鼠的小动物会从地下的洞里钻出来。

items.en: Dear Wang Mei, It isn’t snowing today, but there is still snow on the grass.
items.zh: 亲爱的王梅，今天没下雪，但草地上还有积雪。

items.en: In Edmonton, the spring weather is a little wild.
items.zh: 在埃德蒙顿，春天的天气有点变化无常。

items.en: It can be cold and snowy or warm and sunny.
items.zh: 可能又冷又雪，也可能温暖晴朗。

items.en: The temperature can be as low as -15°C, but it can also reach 15°C.
items.zh: 气温最低能到零下15摄氏度，也可能升到15摄氏度。

items.en: We probably won’t see any flowers until May or June!
items.zh: 我们可能要到五月或六月才能看到花呢！

items.en: After school today, we had so much fun playing outside.
items.zh: 今天放学后，我们在外面玩得可开心了。

items.en: We played “snow” soccer, but we had to wear jackets, jeans, and boots to stay warm.
items.zh: 我们踢了雪地足球，得穿上夹克、牛仔裤和靴子保暖。

items.en: When it gets warmer, we can play in our shorts and T-shirts.
items.zh: 等天气暖和了，我们就能穿短裤T恤去玩了。

items.en: I like spring because there are lots of activities to do, like cycling, having picnics, and hiking.
items.zh: 我喜欢春天，因为有好多活动可以玩，像骑车、野餐和徒步。

items.en: I like the Chinese name for winter jasmine.
items.zh: 我喜欢迎春花的中文名字。

items.en: It’s interesting.
items.zh: 挺有意思的。

items.en: Here, we have Groundhog Day on February 2 for the coming of spring.
items.zh: 我们这儿二月二有土拨鼠日，迎接春天到来。

items.en: Do you know what happens on that day?
items.zh: 你知道那天会发生什么吗？

items.en: Another fun part of spring is going to the sugar bush, a big tree farm in the countryside.
items.zh: 春天另一件好玩的事，是去乡下的糖树林，那是一个大农场。

items.en: We make maple syrup.
items.zh: 我们制作枫糖浆。

items.en: We eat lots of tasty breakfast foods — all with maple syrup on them!
items.zh: 我们吃很多好吃的早餐，全都浇上枫糖浆！

items.en: I love spring activities.
items.zh: 我爱春天的各种活动。

items.en: Talk to you soon!
items.zh: 回头再聊！

items.en: Jenny
items.zh: 詹妮

items.en: In the life skills class last week, we learned about agriculture and plant biology.
items.zh: 上周生活技能课，我们学习了农业和植物学。

items.en: The teacher gave us some seeds so we could observe the growing process of a plant.
items.zh: 老师发给我们一些种子，让我们观察植物的生长过程。

items.en: I picked some pea seeds and planted them in a small pot.
items.zh: 我挑了些豌豆种子，种在小花盆里。

items.en: I watered them every day.
items.zh: 我每天给它们浇水。

items.en: I hope my peas grow quickly!
items.zh: 希望我的豌豆快快长大！

items.en: Here are some of my observations on the peas’ growth:
items.zh: 以下是我对豌豆生长的一些观察：

items.en: Date: March 3 Weather conditions: sunny, temperature around 18°C
items.zh: 日期：三月三日 天气：晴，气温约18摄氏度

items.en: Observations: The pea seeds grew into buds.
items.zh: 观察：豌豆种子发芽了。

items.en: They look like the English letter “Y”.
items.zh: 它们长得像英文字母 Y。

items.en: My peas are growing quickly!
items.zh: 我的豌豆长得真快！

items.en: Date: April 3 Weather conditions: rainy, temperature around 22°C
items.zh: 日期：四月三日 天气：雨，气温约22摄氏度

items.en: Observations: The pea flowers are in full bloom.
items.zh: 观察：豌豆花全开了。

items.en: Some are pink and some are purple.
items.zh: 有的粉，有的紫。

items.en: When the pea plants grow taller, I will give them a shelf to climb on.
items.zh: 等豌豆长高了，我给它们搭个架子爬。

items.en: Date: March 30 Weather conditions: cloudy, temperature around 19°C
items.zh: 日期：三月三十日 天气：多云，气温约19摄氏度

items.en: Observations: Now, there are long, thin stems and some leaves.
items.zh: 观察：现在有了细长的茎和一些叶子。

items.en: At the top of the stems are little flower buds!
items.zh: 茎的顶上还冒出了小花苞！

items.en: I put the pot in the yard.
items.zh: 我把花盆放到了院子里。

items.en: There, they can get some sunshine.
items.zh: 那儿能让它们晒到太阳。

items.en: The 24 solar terms reflect the wisdom of our ancestors.
items.zh: 二十四节气体现了祖先的智慧。

items.en: They help us understand how nature changes throughout the year.
items.zh: 它们帮我们了解大自然一年里的变化。

items.en: Our ancestors observed nature and created the Chinese lunar calendar to guide farming and daily life.
items.zh: 祖先观察自然，创制了农历，指导农耕和日常生活。

items.en: There are several solar terms for the spring season.
items.zh: 春季有好几个节气。

items.en: They tell us about the coming of this beautiful season.
items.zh: 它们告诉我们这个美好季节的到来。

items.en: Start of Spring
items.zh: 立春

items.en: It usually falls around February 4 or 5 and marks the beginning of spring.
items.zh: 它通常在二月四五日，标志着春天开始。

items.en: The weather starts to get warmer and we can see new plants grow and animals become active after a long winter.
items.zh: 天气开始转暖，我们能看到植物发芽、动物在漫长冬天后活跃起来。

items.en: Rain Water
items.zh: 雨水

items.en: It arrives around February 19 or 20.
items.zh: 它在二月十九或二十日前后到来。

items.en: It reminds us of the increase in rainfall as the weather gets warmer.
items.zh: 它提醒我们，天气转暖，雨水增多。

items.en: Jingzhe (Awakening of Insects)
items.zh: 惊蛰（虫儿苏醒）

items.en: It usually takes place around March 5 or 6.
items.zh: 它通常在三月五六日。

items.en: Jingzhe tells us that insects are coming out of hibernation.
items.zh: 惊蛰告诉我们，昆虫正从冬眠中苏醒。

items.en: We might hear more birds singing and see butterflies and bees buzzing around.
items.zh: 我们可能会听到更多鸟鸣，看到蝴蝶蜜蜂飞来飞去。

items.en: Spring Equinox
items.zh: 春分

items.en: It comes around March 20 or 21, when the length of the day is nearly equal to that of the night.
items.zh: 它在三月二十或二十一日，这天昼长几乎和夜长相等。

items.en: Qingming (Clear and Bright)
items.zh: 清明（气清景明）

items.en: It usually falls around April 4 or 5.
items.zh: 它通常在四月四五日。

items.en: Qingming is a time when people honour their ancestors.
items.zh: 清明是人们祭奠祖先的时节。

items.en: It’s also a time to enjoy outdoor activities and the beauty of spring.
items.zh: 也是外出游玩、欣赏春景的好时候。

items.en: Grain Rain
items.zh: 谷雨

items.en: It occurs around April 19 or 20.
items.zh: 它在四月十九或二十日前后。

items.en: Farmers sow seeds during this time, and the rain nourishes the soil to make sure the farmers have a good harvest in the future.
items.zh: 农民这时播种，雨水滋润土地，好让将来有个好收成。

items.en: These solar terms teach us how to follow the seasons and make the best of them.
items.zh: 这些节气教我们如何顺应时令，充分利用它们。

items.en: They show us the relationship between humans and nature and call upon us to respect the world around us.
items.zh: 它们展示了人与自然的关系，也呼吁我们尊重周围的世界。
